description: Adjust the company's email design system (partial update - only pass the fields to change). Affects every future AI-generated email and sequence enrichment. designCode tokens: kickerStyle (chip | letterspaced | none), titleAlignment (left | center), buttonShape (rounded | pill), dividerStyle (line | space), density (airy | compact), openerTreatments (subset of hero-image, hero-color, header-hero, editorial-masthead, title-led). compositionSpine: hero-led | editorial | product-spec. The adjustment is written into the company's emailDesignPrompt direction text (the single source of truth): the new identity's sentences are prepended and any custom prose the text carried is preserved below them. Pass reset: true to clear the direction text and return to brand-derived defaults. Free-form prose edits belong on update_company's emailDesignPrompt instead.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

compositionSpine.description: Which worked-example skeleton anchors generation: designed marketing sections, typography-first editorial, or information-dense product/spec.

designCode.description: Partial visual grammar adjustment; omitted tokens keep their current value.

dividerStyle.description: Thin divider lines between sections, or whitespace only.

kickerStyle.description: How eyebrows above titles render: soft badge chips, letter-spaced uppercase text, or none.

openerTreatments.description: The opener treatments this company's emails may use, primary first.

reset.description: true clears the direction text and returns to brand-derived defaults. Cannot be combined with designCode or compositionSpine.

name: update_email_design_system

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `update_email_design_system` MCP tool.

designSystem.description: The email design system now in effect after the update or reset.

directionText.description: The rewritten direction text now stored on the company; null after a reset.

isDefault.description: True when the resulting identity is the pure brand-derived one - after an explicit reset, or when an adjustment resolved to the derived defaults.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
